General whitening guidance from the ADA ↗
GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
you might be wondering.

Are these two separate products?

Yes. The toothpaste tablets and whitening strips are sold separately, at $29 per pack. Each buy button opens the checkout for that exact product.

What comes in each pack?

The tablet bottle is labelled 30 pieces. The HOOX strips box is labelled 42 pieces, with pouches marked 2 strips. One order contains one pack of the selected product.

Are the tablets meant to be swallowed?

No. These are toothpaste tablets used for brushing, not medicine or food. Follow the instructions on the actual bottle and do not swallow the tablets or toothpaste.

How long do I wear the strips?

The supplied packaging image states 30 minutes. Check the instructions in your actual box for placement, wear time, and frequency. Do not leave them on longer than directed, and keep the gel off your gums.

Are whitening results guaranteed?

No specific shade change or speed of whitening is guaranteed. Results depend on the product, the cause of discolouration, and your teeth. Whitening does not change the colour of crowns, fillings, or veneers.

What if I have sensitive teeth?

Ask your dentist before whitening if you have sensitive teeth, gum problems, or dental restorations. If irritation or sensitivity develops, stop using the product and consult your dentist.

How much is delivery?

Delivery is free and takes up to 2 days. Your selected product is paid for through its own Whop checkout.
